240-4068-5470-8250.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
240-4068-5470-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

1981-2415-2842-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1981-2415-2842-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Blood Artist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3764-3899-4871.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3967-5870.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3967-5870.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2034-4478-6006-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

803-2511-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
803-2511-4302.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

413-7124-7659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
413-7124-7659.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

805-7439.description:
Cast a copy of Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate the ability granted by Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 as desired.
Cast Debt to the Deathless by paying {W}{W}{B}{B} and all remaining available mana, causing each opponent to lose a significant amount of life and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
805-7439.notes: The more life you have, the more life your opponents will lose. You can also add mana as desired from other sources to cast Debt to the Deathless.

4004-6472-7149.description:
Cast Deceptive Frostkite by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Deceptive Frostkite into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Deceptive Frostkite dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Deceptive Frostkite enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Deceptive Frostkite leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Deceptive Frostkite from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-6768-7356.notablePrerequisites: Uthros Research Craft has at least 12 charge counters on it.
3532-5078-6768-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a charge counter from Uthros Research Craft.
Uthros Research Craft and Longshot trigger.
Resolve the Uthros Research Craft trigger, putting a charge counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Longshot trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

3497-4907-6797-6989.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 3 life this turn.
3497-4907-6797-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

240-4068-5470-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
240-4068-5470-5686.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat from step 2.

560-1477-2558-6737.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
When the Soldier enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

413-586-5258-5618-7183.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger, untapping Blasting Station and adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1409-2307-4772.description:
Activate Corsair Captain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Corsair Captain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Corsair Captain.
Resolve the Corsair Captain trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1719-5223-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

250-730-779-1479-1669.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-730-779-1479-1669.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Emeria Angel and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1170-1329-1414-7060.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2511-3652-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1429-6792-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

4050-4484-4924-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
4050-4484-4924-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4050-4484-4924-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

3990-4613-4762.manaNeeded: {3}{G}{G} minus {1}{G}{G} for each +1/+1 counter on Incubation Druid
3990-4613-4762.description:
If Incubation Druid does not have a +1/+1 counter on it, activate its adapt ability by paying {3}{G}{G}, putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Incubation Druid using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Incubation Druid.
Repeat.

1170-1809-2196-2701.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1170-1809-2196-2701.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Frantic Search from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Repeat.

1287-1418-6318.easyPrerequisites: You have either {4}{U}{U} or eight {E} available.
1287-1418-6318.description:
Cast Aethertide Whale by paying eight {E} if able or {4}{U}{U} otherwise.
When Aethertide Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Activate Aethertide Whale by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2609-5195-6259.description:
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {W}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Recruit the Worthy.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

56-4054-4976-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-4054-4976-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Open the Graves triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Repeat.
56-4054-4976-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

2292-3284-4550-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2292-3284-4550-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

678-2499-4050-4151.description:
Cast Vishgraz by paying {2}{W}{B}{G}.
When Vishgraz enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating six 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vishgraz, adding {W}.
When Vishgraz dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Vishgraz from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Phyrexian Mites, adding {2}{B}{G}.
Repeat.

1308-4518-5554.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure or Gold token.
1308-4518-5554.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure or Gold token you control.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, or two Golds by sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

1651-1737-2419-3459.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0}, creating a token copy of Treasure Vault.
When the Treasure Vault token enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Battered Golem and the Treasure Vault token, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

4499-4617-4906.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {2} and copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin abilities, giving all creatures you control trample and adding eight {R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, exiling Soulbright Flameking and returning it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

914-2959-3368.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2959-3368.description:
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying {2}{R}, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Heat Shimmer targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Resolve the copy of Heat Shimmer, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
The Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Activate six Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-2316-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
1308-2316-5231.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

2018-2702-2736-4050.description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {W}{U}{R}, giving Archetype of Imagination to an opponent.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Zedruu, adding one mana of any color.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Zedruu from your graveyard to the battlefield without flying due to Archetype of Imagination.
Repeat from step 2.

2232-2604-5081.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with morph or megamorph.
You have a creature card with morph or megamorph in your hand.
2232-2604-5081.description:
Cast the creature card with morph or megamorph from your hand for its morph cost by paying {0}.
Whenever the face-down creature enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another creature with morph or megamorph to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

224-573-3177.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.
